profiles.companyName: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. Common Stock
profiles.description: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. specializes in the development, production, and distribution of copper-indium-gallium-diselenide (CIGS) photovoltaic products. These solar energy solutions are engineered for diverse applications, spanning the aerospace industry, defense sector, emergency management, and both consumer and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) demands. A notable offering includes their outdoor solar charging devices. The company markets and distributes its goods via a comprehensive network of OEMs, system integrators, wholesalers, retailers, and online e-commerce channels. Founded in 2005, Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. maintains its primary offices in Thornton, Colorado.
